_comment: Active abilities granted by parts (a part's grid.ability names one of these). `free` abilities do not use the machine's action. `cooldown` is in rounds, counted from the round it was used.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: Run up to 3 hexes in a straight line, even after moving, and slam into the first thing in the way: 3 damage, +1 for every hex run first (up to 5), and a shove.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.text: Hook any unit 2-3 hexes away that nothing blocks, and drag it next to you. Dragged over a pit, it falls. Anchored frames cannot be moved.

barricade.name: Barricade
barricade.text: Drop a crate wall on an empty neighbouring hex. It blocks movement and shots until broken (3 HP).

focus.name: Focus
focus.text: Free. Your next attack or Charge this turn deals +2.

dash.name: Dash
dash.text: Free. Move again, up to 2 hexes, even after attacking.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.text: Free. Your next attack or Charge this turn deals +2, for +2 heat.

shield.name: Shield
shield.text: This machine and every ally next to it take 2 less from each hit until your next turn.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.text: Free. Collect a scrap pile up to 2 hexes away (scrap and 2 HP) without moving.
